name: Login Look Customizer
author: Maulik Patel

sections.description:
Login Look Customizer allows you to effortlessly personalize the WordPress login screen to match your brand identity. Whether you’re building client sites or branding your own, this plugin helps you change the WordPress login page logo, background color/image, button styling, and more — all from a simple settings page.

Features:

  • Add a custom logo to the login page.
  • Change login form background and page background with advanced design options.
  • Customize login button and link colors.
  • Enable or disable login design settings as needed.
  • Add Google reCAPTCHA security to the login page.
  • Lightweight and easy to use.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/login-look-customizer.
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Login Look Customizer to configure the options.
sections.faq:
Will this plugin affect other pages?

No. This plugin only affects the WordPress login page (wp-login.php) and not any other part of your site.

Can I use a transparent logo?

Yes, PNG logos with transparency are supported.

How do I reset to the default login look?

Simply remove your settings and save to revert to the WordPress default login screen.
